test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 5 Feb 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which one of the following is the main source of power generation in India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Thermal power.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Thermal power**

 
 
• A thermal power station is the power station in which heat energy is converted into electric power.
 
• Thermal power is the **largest source** of power in India.
 
• There are different types of thermal power plants based on the fuel.
 
• They are used to generate steam such as coal, gas, and diesel, natural gas.
 
• About **71%** of electricity consumed in India is generated by thermal power plants.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Solar power**

 
 
• Solar power in India is a fast developing industry as part of the renewable energy in India.
 
• The country's solar installed capacity was** 57.705 GW **as of **30 June 2022.**
 
• The Indian Government had an initial target of **20 GW capacity for 2022**, which was achieved four years ahead of schedule
 
 
 
• **Nuclear power**
 
 
• Nuclear power is the** fifth-largest source** of electricity in India.
 
• As of March 2017, India has** 22 nuclear reactors** in operation at seven sites, having an installed capacity of 6780 MW.
 
• It produces a total of **30,292.91 GWh** of electricity.
 
• 11 more reactors are under construction to generate an additional 8,100 MW.
 
 
 
• **Hydro power**
 
 
• **India is 5th** globally for installed hydroelectric power capacity
 
• India's hydroelectric power potential is estimated at **148,700 MW** at **60% of** load factor.
 
• In the fiscal year 2019–20, the total hydroelectric power generated in India was 156 TWh.
